name: AI Celebrity Spokesperson Ad Campaign
description: A real-estate developer's marketing team plans to use a generative-AI video and voice-cloning tool to produce advertisements in which a well-known Saudi actor appears to personally recommend a new residential project. The videos will be sent by automated WhatsApp broadcast to a purchased list of 250,000 phone numbers and posted on social media.
documentation:
SYNTHETIC MEDIA: the actor's face and voice are cloned from public interviews and TV clips using a third-party SaaS tool hosted outside the Kingdom. The actor has NOT given written consent; the agency says a verbal agreement is 'in progress'. The videos are not labelled as AI-generated and there is no watermark.
CONTENT: the synthetic actor states the project is 'guaranteed to double in value within 3 years'.
AUDIENCE DATA: 250,000 mobile numbers purchased from a data broker; the source and consent basis of the list are unknown. The WhatsApp broadcast is fully automated with no opt-out message.
PERSONALISATION: the tool also generates personalised versions that greet each recipient by name, using names from the purchased list.
VENDOR: no data processing agreement with the video tool vendor; vendor terms allow it to reuse uploaded content to train its models.
REVIEW: no legal or compliance review has been done; launch planned in two weeks.
